name: INDA 2
source:
The second bullet in erotic keyboard lessons - now with strengthened erotic aspect. This time successes and failures are not only accompanied by voice, but by animation as well. 
Native English speakers read English sentences, so it's a good way to brush up English skills. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
